findings.title: Spacing off the 4 px grid (12 value(s), 240 of 653 uses)
findings.fix: use the spacing tokens; 1-2 px values are usually borders or browser defaults

findings.title: 9 font sizes
findings.expected: about 8 sizes at most, all from one scale, none within 10% of another (preflight 7)
findings.fix: map each size to the nearest step of one scale

findings.title: Font sizes between whole pixels
findings.expected: whole-pixel sizes from the scale: a fluid size (clamp, vw) or an rem step that does not land on a pixel gives a different size at every width, so nothing matches (preflight 7)
findings.fix: step the size at breakpoints instead of a fluid clamp, or round the scale to whole pixels; 13.33 px on a button is the browser default

findings.title: Font weights one step apart
findings.measured: 400 on 107 element(s), 600 on 20 element(s), 700 on 6 element(s); 600 and 700 are one step apart, which can read as a mistake rather than a level
findings.expected: three weights at most in a system, and two in any one view, clearly apart, such as 400 and 600 (DC-L19-24; it marks two neighbouring weights reading as a mistake as inferred)
findings.fix: give each weight a job (body, labels, headings) and merge the near ones; try size or space before a third weight

findings.title: Text smaller than 12 px
findings.measured: 11 px: 'آخر 7 أيام' in section.min-w-0.rounded:nth-of-type(5) > div:nth-of-type(2) > p.text-xs.text-muted
findings.fix: raise it to a text style

findings.title: 4 button styles
findings.measured: outline, 7 px corners, 36 px tall, 14 px: "English"; outline, 7 px corners, 36 px tall, 15 px: "إنشاء صفحة"; filled, 7 px corners, 36 px tall, 15 px: "إنشاء مقال"; outline, 7 px corners, 36 px tall, 15 px caps: "مفتاح API جديد"; UPPERCASE and normal case mixed
findings.expected: a primary, a secondary and at most one quieter style, sharing one corner shape, one case and a height scale such as 32, 40 and 48 px (DC-L08-05; DC-L08-07; STD-visual-details-36)
findings.fix: make every button from one component with a size and a variant; the corner shape is one decision for all of them

findings.title: Before launch: share image, favicon or indexing
findings.measured: missing a share image (og:image), a favicon, a meta description; robots says noindex, nofollow
findings.expected: a public page has a share image, a favicon and a description; noindex only on drafts

findings.title: Controls placed outside the page box
findings.expected: a skip link that appears on focus is fine; anything else is off-canvas content
findings.fix: Tab to it and confirm it appears

findings.title: 3 color families on one page
findings.measured: teal (#246b73) x6; yellow (#7a5406, #fcf0d7, #f7eccb) x3; green (#125e44) x1
findings.expected: grays, one accent with one job, and status colors (DC-L01-08), with the danger color only on the part that is going wrong (making.md section 12: "More visual" means more information, not more colour)
findings.fix: pick the one accent; turn decorative colors gray; keep status colors for status, and red only on the part that is going wrong

findings.title: Colors that look the same but are typed differently (2 groups)
findings.measured: #e0f2ea x1 = #dcefe7 x1; #e7effd x1 = #ecebfc x1 = #e7f0f5 x1 (18 opaque colors in all)
findings.expected: one value per color, named once and reused (STD-visual-details-26: never a parallel set; preflight 2: count the values that do not come from one system)
findings.fix: keep the most used value in each group and replace the others with it: the first step towards a palette

findings.title: Negative margins in use
findings.expected: usually a workaround that overlaps neighbours
